sources.quote: Generative technologies are used in Korea. IL-2 Series as production tools for selected types of content: in-game radio communications, pilot portraits and images used in Career mode. Radio communications use text-to-speech technology based on voice recordings made by our team and voice actors under the relevant agreements. Pilot portraits and Career mode images are created with AI-assisted workflows based on our own assets, in-game screenshots, models, and historical references, then manually reviewed and refined by our artists. Generative AI is not used as a replacement for creative direction. All such content is curated, checked, and finalized by the development team.

sources.quote:
A strange change from GB is the frequency of the AI wingman's callouts to you in mission. Sure, 'Bauke Bauke' is burnt into my brain, and supposedly the new voice system should keep callouts more helpful. But its the volume of callouts thats gone down, and the game is worse for it. I was flying my MiG-15 career, and got into a furball with Sabers. At no time did the AI give me a 'bandits, four low' or even a 'Tally!' or whatever the North Korean/Russian equivalent is. Maybe I forgot to explicitly order them to tally bandits, but why do I need to tell the AI to do this at all, wouldn't standing doctrine be to do this? Something established in training? But its not just in air callouts either, the AI seems very hit or miss with whenever any voice communication occurs. I give commands and they just... say nothing. Not even a confirmation? Something seems almost bugged in the behavior. Its a small thing, but very frustrating.
LukeFF View Profile View Posts [developer] Nov 1 @ 1:49pm Report this post You can order them to or to not call out enemy contacts from the command menu. #1
PopaStern View Profile View Posts Nov 1 @ 1:53pm Report this post The Ai behavior is set on automatic by default and act on everything without requiring your flight lead input. This also means that they often won't respond to your commands. If you would rather they obey to your commands, mostly, go to settings/game/artificial intelligence and select the option "Maintain Formation". I noticed more radio replies when this is turned on, such as flight formation confirmations. I also would like having more control on radio volume in the future. My biggest negative on this topic is the often uncomprehensible ai voices forcing me to open my map screen to read the chat bubbles. I read that a voice rework is in the works so we can expect things to get better. Fly safe! #2
BeondTheGrave View Profile View Posts 15 hours ago Report this post Originally posted by LukeFF : You can order them to or to not call out enemy contacts from the command menu. Which is inconsistent, half the time they *still* don't do it, and anyway should be the default behavior and *not* something I have to check each sortie. In general, as I note above, the AI seems to only ever half reply to your commands which means you really don't know if the command has taken, if the behavior has changed, etc. until after its too late. Poor response to player input. The Ai behavior is set on automatic by default and act on everything without requiring your flight lead input. This also means that they often won't respond to your commands. If you would rather they obey to your commands, mostly, go to settings/game/artificial intelligence and select the option "Maintain Formation". I noticed more radio replies when this is turned on, such as flight formation confirmations. Thanks I will try this and see if it helps. A voice rework would be very appreciated overall. I've slowly come to 'understand' the AI voice, whenever it does trigger, but its like learning greek it can be very garbled. The Korean voices in my MiG-15 are quite poor, coming from someone whose been trying to learn Korean a few years now. I don't hate what theyre going for with this new voice system, but where it is now is unnecessarily challenging. #3
LukeFF View Profile View Posts [developer] 11 hours ago Report this post Originally posted by PopaStern : The Ai behavior is set on automatic by default and act on everything without requiring your flight lead input. This also means that they often won't respond to your commands. If you would rather they obey to your commands, mostly, go to settings/game/artificial intelligence and select the option "Maintain Formation". I noticed more radio replies when this is turned on, such as flight formation confirmations. I also would like having more control on radio volume in the future. My biggest negative on this topic is the often uncomprehensible ai voices forcing me to open my map screen to read the chat bubbles. I read that a voice rework is in the works so we can expect things to get better. Fly safe! Yes, we are continuing to work on improving the system. BTW, you can control the radio volume just like in GB. The only limitation right now is the radio beacon volume is tied to it as well. #4
